snippet.title: Blockappend Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A 3D isometric puzzle game where you create shapes by appending blocks together. Arriving sometime next year, probably earlyish in the year.

Wishlist on steam today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2249120/Blockappend/
